title: Phase 4: Documentation and Disclaimer additions for analytics skill
outcome: Implemented Phase 4 of the analytics skill bug fixes plan: added cache hit rate tooltip to summary cards, productive sessions estimation note to productivity notes, and simulated estimates gotchas to SKILL.md. All 108 tests pass (7 new Phase 4 tests added).
key_decisions: Used HTML title attribute for cache hit rate tooltip in summary cards — provides hover explanation without visual clutter
Added estimation note to both build_productivity_section() and build_productivity_notes() for consistency across rendering paths
SKILL.md already had partial coverage of cache estimation; added two explicit gotchas calling out cache hit rate as simulated and productive sessions as token-ratio estimated
build_cache_cards() already contained a disclaimer paragraph about simulated prefix caching, so no additional change was needed there
learnings: The render_consolidated_report.py module has duplicated notes paragraphs in build_productivity_section() and build_productivity_notes() — changes must be applied to both for consistency
Phase 4 documentation changes benefit from automated tests that verify HTML output contains expected disclaimer phrases, ensuring disclaimers are not accidentally removed in future edits
The existing test pattern of checking for keyword phrases in HTML output is effective for documentation/disclaimer verification
